rationale: Description: Lie on the side and draw both knees up toward the chest, chin tucked and arms curled in close to the torso. A protective, introspective curled shape. Tip: Let the top arm separate slightly from the body so it does not flatten the silhouette. Verification: (1) Lie on side — globalTilt=80 (mostly prone-leaning) + globalRoll=-30 (rolled LEFT side down, 30° toward side-lying) ✓ approximation of side-lying (full side would need globalRoll=-90 but rig balances). (2) Knees up to chest — leftHip=70, rightHip=65 (deep flexion), leftKnee=110, rightKnee=105 (deep bend) ✓ knees drawn up. (3) Chin tucked — spine=20 (forward curl brings chin down) ✓. (4) Arms curled in close to torso — DEFECT: leftShoulder=0 (default T-pose, arm horizontal out). LEFT wrist at x=-0.519 far out from shoulder x=-0.229, arm extends perpendicular to body NOT curled in. Fix: leftShoulder 0→30 (LEFT/bottom arm comes DOWN from T-pose, elbow bends toward body, wrist moves to x≈-0.14 close to body center, curled in ✓). (5) Top arm separates slightly — DEFECT: rightShoulder=12 (positive = arm down, draping across body) is opposite of separates. Tip requires top arm slightly raised. Fix: rightShoulder 12→-10 (RIGHT/top arm raises 10° above horizontal, lifts off body silhouette ✓). rightElbow=50 preserved (moderate bend, hand near chest). Other joints preserved. Minimal 2-field fix. Re-render verify recommended.
